C1671.title: Claude Code GitHub Action Vulnerability Leaks Workflow Secrets
C1671.summary: Microsoft's threat intelligence team discovered a prompt injection vulnerability in Claude Code's GitHub Action that allows attackers to access sensitive secrets within CI/CD workflows under specific conditions. The flaw highlights how AI-powered CI/CD tools can become a new vector for credential leakage.

references.title: Securing CI/CD in an Agentic World: Claude Code Github Action Case
